::: {.callout-note}
## This analysis has moved

The analysis, code and results for the *Mucor* strains JEM1 and JEM2 are now kept in the
MorenoLab repository. A public summary is at
<https://lab.stajich.org/MorenoLab_Mucor_Marchantia/>. The full analysis is lab-only until the
paper is published.
:::

## Summary

Two *Mucor* strains, JEM1 and JEM2, were isolated from the liverwort *Marchantia*. JEM1 is
*Mucor hiemalis* and JEM2 is *Mucor circinelloides* (top ITS hit against UNITE v10, 99.3 % and
98.6 % identity). The study asks which of their secreted proteins could act as effectors and
whether any could interact with host plant proteins. Every candidate is a computational
prediction. None has been expressed or assayed.
